note: Both sets misbind the detail marks: A4/A1 and B4/B1 are swapped relative to the sheet (A4 = FLOOR BEAM @ GRID 2, A1 = FLOOR BEAM @ GRID 6, B1 = FLOOR BEAMNEAR GRID 5, B4 = FLOOR BEAM @ GRID 3), so each has four misbound claims. Set A adds two further defects: it truncates the C1 beam name to 'ROOF BEAM @ GRID 6', dropping '& NEAR GRID 5', and repeats the E6 roof-beam claim twice (once with and once without the E6 mark). Set B keeps the full C1 name and has no duplicate, so B is the cleaner set despite sharing the mark mix-ups.
remarks: Both extractions appear to pair each detail mark with the wrong detail title in the same way (A4/A1 and B4/B1 swapped), suggesting a systematic mark-to-title association bug rather than random error. Both also omit the 'ø 3"' opening diameter shown on the W8X13 roof-beam details. The text layer is a flat token stream with no positional binding, so mark-to-detail pairing must come from the image.
